02-PRD / Direct Response Product Scouting

Goes here. Frameworks and active sourcing tactics for identifying high-converting e-commerce products using ad intelligence tools (Get Hooked, FB Ad Library) and native ad placements. Focuses on identifying problem-solution physical goods targeted at older demographics with high purchasing power.

Not here. • Writing or producing the actual ad creatives -> [03-CRE] / Performance Ad Creative • Building the Shopify store or advertorial pages -> [05-WEB] / Landing Page Architecture • Supplier sourcing, inventory purchasing, and logistics -> [06-OPS] / Supply Chain & Sourcing

Topics. • Core Product Criteria
Deep emotional or physical problem resolution (e.g., daily chronic pain, child sleep issues, incontinence).
Lack of retail availability (not sold in big-box stores). • Intelligence Tooling (Get Hooked / Ad Spy Platforms)
Parameter configuration for finding proven winners.
Platform selection based on demographic intent. • Native Ad Scouting
Leveraging publisher widgets (Taboola/Outbrain style) on news aggregators.
Demographic mapping to native placements (60+ audience). • Validation & Angle Mining (FB Ad Library)
Cross-referencing product viability via free tools.
Extracting marketing avatars from longest-running creatives.
Look for. • Get Hooked (or equivalent ad spy tool) exact filter mechanics:
Location: USA.
Performance: Top performing.
Frequency capping: Max 4 ads per brand (to reduce noise).
Format: Video.
Status: Currently running.
Minimum Runtime: 14 days (proves baseline profitability).
Channel: Facebook (targets older, higher-converting demographic).

Brand active ads: >50 (indicates high scale and budget). • Native Scouting mechanics: Refreshing paid content widgets on sites like weather.com or CNN to identify recurring health/wellness offers (e.g., neuropathy, tinnitus, bladder control). • Ad Library Validation mechanics: Search product keyword -> Filter by "Images" (to find native-style ads) -> Verify ads have been active for >1 week. • Angle extraction method: Locate the longest-running ad for a validated product and duplicate the specific avatar and messaging angle.

Skip. Do not capture mentions of TikTok or Instagram "burner" accounts (explicitly flagged as outdated/ineffective). Ignore promotional mentions of tool bundles (e.g., Luxury Extras). Do not capture basic dropshipping definitions or supplier platform names like AliExpress/Calata.
Scope mix. 10% baseline (fundamental product criteria), 90% growth (active, tool-driven acquisition tactics).
Volume. ~250 words.
